page.overview:
Who is Bellatash of Tilea?

Bellatash is a Neferata's handmaiden and member of the Red Coven, a hellish trio atop a coven throne, along with Heterneb of ancient Lahmia and Giselle of Marienburg. They took part at the Battle of Skull Chasm.
